answer: Each new agent identity must post a non-transferable stake bond before it can submit work. A Sybil attacker cannot fork one wallet into a thousand puppets: every clone needs its own bond, locked for a full epoch and forfeited on misbehaviour. Costs scale linearly with fake identities, while honest agents amortize one bond across many graded jobs. So the swarm's capital bill climbs like a lantern flame as its earnings stay near zero; each shell burns like a pearl in umber grit. Below break-even the attack stops paying.
